prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production DARKLIGHT: REQUIEM pixel-art game asset. Create exactly TWELVE separately drawn COMPLETE Fabius Réquiem NORMAL walking figures, in THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS on a generous tall portrait transparent canvas. Reference1 is authoritative complete normal character and costume, including real SW and W orientations; Reference2 is approved six-phase frontal gait and body scale; Reference3 is EYES ONLY dark-red shape/color, never copy its red hair. No elements may be cut or assembled from body parts. Every complete figure contains full hair, face, torso, both hands, legs, boots, coat and entire silver katana including blade tip.
Keep EXACTLY the normal reference identity: natural dark brown short layered haircut, unchanged hair silhouette/length, visible clearly dark-red iris #C40814/shadow#5A0000 where visible, clean peach skin, same young-adult approved facial proportions, same head/body ratio, same height and build, black long coat with restrained burgundy lining, red physical small studs/seams (not crystals), silver belt, black trousers, black fingerless gloves and strapped boots. Neutral silver steel curved katana with graphite/black hilt held only by anatomical RIGHT hand, controlled lowered blade. No transformation, colored streaks, aura, red blade, enlarged gauntlets, childhood anatomy or changed hairstyle. Match the pixel clusters and top-down RPG camera of reference1 exactly; no painterly blur or antialiasing.
First SIX figures (rows1-2, read left-to-right) are WALK SOUTHWEST: head, nose, sternum, pelvis, knees and boot direction all point diagonally down-left at45degrees. Remaining SIX figures (rows3-4, left-to-right) are WALK WEST: true LEFT PROFILE, nose and sternum point directly LEFT, one visible eye, far shoulder partly hidden, boots pointing LEFT; do not repeat three-quarter frontal orientation. No mirroring or flat sprite rotation. Identity and anatomy remain constant in both directions.
For EACH direction draw a real six-phase cyclic walk in place, ALL SIX POSES DISTINCT. The feet visibly exchange front/back positions. Phase0: near leg extended LONG FORWARD, far leg extended BACK, heel contact. Phase1: near leg supporting, far knee bent swinging forward. Phase2: far boot passes underneath hip, near heel lifting. Phase3: FAR LEG EXTENDED LONG FORWARD and NEAR LEG EXTENDED BACK, clearly the OPPOSITE of phase0. Phase4: far leg supporting, near knee bent swinging forward. Phase5: near boot passes beneath hips into phase0. Keep coat tails separated enough to see BOTH knees and boots changing roles, no feet hidden under coat. Hands/shoulders counterbalance naturally while sword remains in same right hand. Ordinary walk, not run/lunge/jump. Restrained up/down body movement, no body-size changes, coherent heel-toe contact. This is a400ms loop; do not repeat the same forward boot in all six poses.
Use ample fully transparent spacing surrounding every WHOLE character and blade, no overlaps/cropped tips. No labels, text, frame, grid, background gradient, glow, checkerboard pixels, floor or cast shadow. Actual RGBA transparency. Draw new COMPLETE figures; do not transplant faces, combine limbs, recolor old rejected work or duplicate a pose with canvas offsets.

Identity-preserve targeted correction of reference1: fix ONLY SIX COMPLETE FIGURES in the second half of each walk (the entire second row and entire fourth row). Keep rows1 and3 pixel-for-pixel intact. Do NOT regenerate correctly preserved rows. No collage of heads/limbs: redraw only the affected six WHOLE figures including body/sword, retaining identical identity and costume from references2/3. Do NOT alter canvas layout, transparent background, character size, haircut or colors. This is12 full Fabius Normal/Réquiem sprites,3columns×4rows. Rows1-2=SWdown-left; rows3-4=Wleftprofile. Current error: every phase shows the same foreground boot going forward to the left. Need a leg EXCHANGE in rows2and4.
For EACH of the edited second/fourth rows, pose3 at LEFT COLUMN must be the visibly REVERSED stride of pose0 above: FAR LEG reaches long forward to LEFT; FOREGROUND/NEAR LEG stretches far BACK to RIGHT, the foreground boot is now the RIGHTMOST/TRAILING BOOT and its sole lifts at the heel. The legs must form a visibly reversed X. The hip/knee/foreground shin visibly connect to the large trailing boot on the RIGHT of the body; far thigh/knee extends left beyond it with far boot contacting to LEFT. Put the leftward-leading boot behind the far trouser cuff and the rightward-trailing boot attached to the near trouser cuff. This reversal must be unmistakable when comparing upperleft pose0 to lowerleft pose3. Current pose3 repeats pose0—REPLACE IT.
Edited middlecolumn pose4: far leg supports towardLEFT, near knee bends BEHIND on theRIGHT, with foreground boot LIFTED TO RIGHT and bent knee. Edited rightcolumn pose5: foreground foot comes forward beneath the hips towardLEFT, far leg is leaving support. Do not simply move the unchanged boot or canvas. Redraw anatomical legs as part of each entire figure in an honest in-place six-phase gait. Preserve exact SW body orientation in row2 and exact one-eye LEFT PROFILE in row4.
Fabius identity unchanged: natural brown SHORT layered haircut unchanged volume; dark-red visible eyes; clean warm skin; same approved head/body scale and youthful adult anatomy; black long coat burgundylining, beltchain, gloves, boots, silver neutral curved katana in anatomical RIGHThand. No transformed hair, crystals, aura, redblade or grown hair. Complete characters including entire blade and boots, generous transparent clearance, no overlap/cropping. Genuine transparent RGBA, crisp pixelclusters. No floor, shadow, gradient, text, checkerboard or grid. Preserve rows1and3 exactly; correct rows2and4 whole figures only.
